program: Survivor legal advocacy, trauma counseling and family safety
priceScope: Conditional annual whole-recipient cost divided by a limited modeled local channel; not a verified marginal gift offer or complete portfolio EV

what: AVDA provides legal advocacy and trauma support for domestic-abuse survivors in Greater Houston and neighboring counties.
It helps with safety planning, protective orders, divorce, custody, referrals and access to financial resources.
Our initial estimate covers a conditional survivor-safety and household-resource channel, not all battering-intervention and prevention work.
strengths: Legal advocacy and counseling have plausible connections to safety, health and net resources.
Current primary sources describe court-fee requirements, representation and alternative services.
The model includes counterparty losses rather than treating support payments as free new wealth.
reservations: The latest reviewed cost is FY 2023, while its survivor-count narrative explicitly describes 2022.
Adult and child survivors are not distinct successful households; our mapping and health effects are judgments.
Safety, retaliation, payer incidence and additional outcomes require deeper evidence before a giving recommendation.

sections.what: AVDA provides legal advocacy and trauma support for domestic-abuse survivors in Greater Houston and neighboring counties. It helps with safety planning, protective orders, divorce, custody, referrals and access to financial resources. Our initial estimate covers a conditional survivor-safety and household-resource channel, not all battering-intervention and prevention work.
sections.monitoring: Request current distinct survivor households, completed legal outcomes, trauma-care dose and safety against alternative legal aid or counseling. The FY 2023 return repeats a 2022 count of 6,366 adult and child survivors; do not call it current or matched FY 2023 output. Cumulative support for more than 100,000 survivors over 45 years is not annual throughput. Homepage 2025 counters were not independently text-extracted. Counseling pages disagree on age eligibility, so confirm this directly rather than publishing a fixed age threshold.
sections.qualitative: Legal advocacy and counseling have plausible connections to safety, health and net resources. Current primary sources describe court-fee requirements, representation and alternative services. The model includes counterparty losses rather than treating support payments as free new wealth. The latest reviewed cost is FY 2023, while its survivor-count narrative explicitly describes 2022. Adult and child survivors are not distinct successful households; our mapping and health effects are judgments. Safety, retaliation, payer incidence and additional outcomes require deeper evidence before a giving recommendation. Houston AVDA has legal EIN 74-2141981, with the same downtown Houston location and services as the original return. It is not Florida’s similarly named organization at avdaonline.org, EIN 59-2486620. The official donation route is avda.org/donate/.
sections.cost: The conditional annual partial-channel reference is $3.11 million per ten combined healthy-year welfare equivalents: 11.670245 clinical QALYs and 1.377352 signed resource equivalents. $10,000 corresponds to 0.032203 combined equivalents under proportional annual accounting, not demonstrated next-gift response. Full annual recognized recipient cost is $4,051,637. Judgments: historical 6,366 adult-and-child survivor opportunities × household uniqueness 0.5 × incremental outcome 0.3 gives 954.9 exposed households. Clinical response 0.25 gives 238.725 health responders at utility 0.03 for two years after a half-year delay. One survivor health unit per household is modeled; children, counseling clients, BIPP participants and outreach attendees are not added independently. All exposed households retain full 0.001 QALY harm and $100 court, travel or access-time burden. A 30% resource response gets one year of $1,500 disposable work resources, $100 actual otherwise-paid medical costs and $800 public-benefit or child-support resources. Positive components alone receive overlap 0.5 before one joint household log. Houston share 0.9 is a judgment. Union 954.9 household proxies contains clinical subgroup 238.725; no separate clinical population is added. One welfare-equivalent adult per household at $25,000 annual consumption, with components netted before one log. Positive components alone receive overlap adjustment; negative components, all unavoidable costs and union harms remain full. Clinical failure retains resource exposures and burdens. ResourceYears is fraction of one year’s gain, not repeated lifetime payments. No retail medicines, gross salaries, ordinary survivor earnings or property wealth are counted. Transfer resources exclude AVDA-funded emergency cash already paid through the annual cost numerator. Each successful resource household carries a full $800 payer/counterparty loss with no positive-overlap discount. A distinct dispersed 10,000-household payer reference at $35,000 baseline bears losses for Houston-attributed recipients, with editionShare 1; local share is applied once, not a second time to the payer log. This broad payer mapping is a sensitivity prior, not observed family incidence. Public benefits, support owed by partners and recipients retaining their own earnings differ; joint household net resources prevent counting the same family money twice. Work gains are after tax, benefit withdrawal and recurring work expenses, not gross salary; separate access burdens are not subtracted again from workGain. Retaliation, litigation costs, reduced support and employment displacement have adverse cases. Central external partner costs remain unknown-neutral; the central public-payer loss is explicitly included, not assumed zero or complete world net benefit. Other programs and external opportunity costs remain unknown; whole recipient cost versus this narrow channel is not complete portfolio EV or a marginal gift offer.
sections.funding: Current legal representation is free or low cost, but expanded working-poor clients may pay court costs and fees. Existing public aid, other legal providers, courts and counseling remain in the counterfactual. Recipient donation appeals do not establish the next unrestricted gift’s response. A newer FY 2024 audit is listed but its original download was inaccessible; the index flags a material weakness. This is a control warning, not verified audit costs or a fraud finding.

Original FY 2023 IRS return and explicitly 2022 survivor narrative
Newer audit availability and control flag, original audit not reviewed

model.costScope: Full reviewed FY 2023 annual operating cost versus one historical survivor-safety and resources channel, with explicitly unmatched cost and output vintages. Not complete portfolio EV or a marginal gift offer.
model.geographicAttribution: Legal services cover Austin, Fort Bend, Harris, Waller, Grimes and Washington counties; Grimes and Washington are outside Houston MSA. Counseling is Harris-only. Judged local share 0.9, not all statewide victims.
model.formula: Health = (clinicalN × unique × b × clinicalResponse × q × finite discounted duration − N × unique × b × union harm discounted at onset) × edition share. Income = signed joint household log welfare equivalents with positive-only overlap and full costs. Better-life cost = 10 × full annual cost / (health + income), only when combined benefits are positive.
model.counterfactual: Other legal aid, public protection and benefit systems, affordable private counsel where available, alternative counseling, family support and case outcomes without this provider.
model.attribution: Annual incremental recipient response is distinct from cohort deduplication and geographic share; no claim of whole annual portfolio or marginal donation causal effect.
model.uncertainty: Source-grounded original cost/services; all causal mapping, utility and net resource priors unsupported. Complete portfolio and marginal donor EV unknown.
model.nativeOutcomes: Historical adult/child survivor support; legal resolutions and counseling are not measured causal QALYs or net income. BIPP and education remain unmodeled, not assumed worthless.
